name: LL Review — OONR hold-harmless N, SPI-NOA does not match the claim procedure
description: Twelve guided steps, one per numbered step of the LL Review 687.1 source document: identify the PX_ONR / PX_687 pair, read the OONR hold-harmless note, skip guided resolution, validate, set the L/R indicator, bypass PX_687 with PX_VM, validate again, confirm the ASO funding arrangement, review the SPI-NOA limited liability record against the claim's date of service and procedure code, and pay the claim.

steps.name: Identify the PX_ONR and PX_687 events
steps.description: Open the Event Resolution tab and review the events associated with the claim. PX_687 is the active hard edit, and its companion event, PX_ONR, indicates that an Out-of-Network Review (ONR) is required. To determine whether the procedure code requires authorization, look for the PX_687 event in the Event Resolution tab. In this example, both PX_ONR and PX_687 events are present, which confirms that authorization is required.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is opened — it is the flow's default tab, so the step completes on arrival.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', the Active Edit section shows Edit Code PX_687 with a Hard Edit badge and PX_ONR as its companion event. The All Edits section lists all four events so you can check the hierarchy.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the PX_ONR and PX_687 events

steps.name: Read the OONR hold-harmless comment in the claim notes
steps.description: Open the Notes tab and look through the WGS notes for the out-of-network review hold-harmless comment. It reads either 'OONR HOLD HARMLESS Y' or 'OONR HOLD HARMLESS N'. A Y means the member is held harmless and the claim takes a different route; an N means the hold-harmless protection does not apply, so you carry on resolving PX_687. On this claim the comment reads 'OONR HOLD HARMLESS N', so proceed to the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Notes tab is opened; the hold-harmless value is read, not graded, because the branch it selects is the flow's own Pay outcome.
steps.hint: On 'Notes', read the WGS Notes section. One of the three lines carries the OONR hold-harmless indicator — here it is 'OONR HOLD HARMLESS N', so the member is not held harmless and you continue.
steps.checklistItem: Read the OONR hold-harmless comment in the claim notes

steps.name: Return to Event Resolution and locate the Skip guided Resolution checkbox
steps.description: To process the claim at PAR benefits, navigate to the Event Resolution tab. In the Guided Resolution section, carries a checkbox labelled 'Skip guided Resolution'.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee RETURNS to the Event Resolution tab after this step activates. The plain tab_visited trigger would be satisfied by step_001's visit; this variant requires a fresh visit, so the trainee actually navigates back from the Notes tab.
steps.hint: Navigate back to 'Event Resolution'. The Guided Resolution section holds a checkbox labelled 'Skip guided Resolution'.
steps.checklistItem: Return to Event Resolution and locate the Skip guided Resolution checkbox

steps.name: Tick the Skip guided Resolution checkbox
steps.description: Select the "Skip Guided Resolution" checkbox in the Guided Resolution section.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when eventResolution.skipGuidedResolution is set to true — no other interaction on this tab completes it.
steps.hint: Click the 'Skip guided Resolution' checkbox so that it is ticked.
steps.checklistItem: Tick the Skip guided Resolution checkbox

steps.name: Click Validate on the claim header
steps.description: Click the Validate button located in the Claim Summary section at the top of the workspace.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes on the first press of the header Validate control. The same control completes step_009 on its second press, after the bypass code is selected.
steps.hint: The Validate button sits in the claim summary bar at the top of the screen, beside Submit. Click it once — the Validation section then reads 'Benefits applied'.
steps.checklistItem: Click Validate on the claim header

steps.name: Check the L/R indicator on the Payment Info tab
steps.description: Next, go to the Payment Information tab and review the L/R Indicator in the Provider section. If the L/R Indicator is already populated with "P", proceed to the next step. If the field is blank, enter "P" and then continue with processing. In this scenario, the L/R Indicator does not contain a value, so update the field to "P" and proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Payment Info tab is opened.
steps.hint: On 'Payment Info', the Provider section holds the 'L/R Ind' field. It is an editable text box and it is currently empty.
steps.checklistItem: Check the L/R indicator on the Payment Info tab

steps.name: Set the L/R indicator to P
steps.description: The L/R indicator is empty on this claim, so type 'P' into it to process the claim at PAR benefits, then proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when paymentInfo.provider.lrIndicator is set to P. Grading trims and case-folds, so a lower-case p is credited; any other value is not.
steps.hint: Type 'P' into the 'L/R Ind' field in the Provider section of the Payment Info tab.
steps.checklistItem: Set the L/R indicator to P

steps.name: Select bypass code PX_VM for the PX_687 event
steps.description: Return to the Event Resolution tab and open the Bypass Codes section. Select the bypass code that applies to the PX_687 event — PX_VM — from the list.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when eventResolution.bypassCode is PX_VM. Selecting any other option in the list leaves the step open.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', open the 'Bypass code' select in the Bypass Codes section and choose PX_VM.
steps.checklistItem: Select bypass code PX_VM for the PX_687 event

steps.name: Click Validate on the claim header a second time
steps.description: Click the Validate button on the claim summary, so the system applies the PX_VM bypass you have just selected.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes on the second press of the header Validate control. The press only counts once step_008 has completed, which is what guarantees the bypass code was set to PX_VM first.
steps.hint: Click 'Validate' on the claim header again — the same button as step 5. The Bypass Codes section then confirms the PX_VM bypass.
steps.checklistItem: Click Validate on the claim header a second time

steps.name: Confirm the funding arrangement on the Benefits sub-tab
steps.description: Identify whether the funding arrangement is ASO or Fully insured. Open the Search tab and its Benefits sub-tab, then read the Funding arrangement field in the General Information section. If the contract is ASO you must review the SPI-NOA / SPI-CLM limited liability records for hold-harmless language; if it is Fully insured no such review is needed. This funding arrangement is ASO, so go on to check the available limited liability records.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Benefits sub-tab is opened.
steps.hint: On 'Search' → 'Benefits', the General Information section shows 'Funding arrangement'. It reads ASO on this contract, so the limited liability records must be reviewed.
steps.checklistItem: Confirm the funding arrangement on the Benefits sub-tab

steps.name: Review the SPI-NOA limited liability record against the claim
steps.description: Open the Search tab's Limited Liability sub-tab. The member's records appear under Limited Liability Results. Under the Type column look for an SPI-NOA or SPI-CLM record whose date range covers the claim's date of service — the date of service is on the Claim Lines tab, and on this claim it is 01/15/2026. The SPI-NOA record runs 01/01/2026 to 01/31/2026, which covers 01/15/2026, so now review the Notes section within the LL record and read comments to identify if it applies to the current claim. For now, open it with 'Open record' and read its Notes. The note instructs allowing procedure code 99213 at $100. Check the procedure code on the Claim Lines tab: on this claim the procedure code is 36415, not 99213. As a result, the procedure code does not match criteria, hence ignore the instructions and proceed to the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the SPI-NOA record is opened. The SPI-MMS row's own Open record control dispatches a different action that completes no step.
steps.hint: On 'Search' → 'Limited Liability', click 'Open record' on the SPI - NOA row (01/01/2026 – 01/31/2026) and read its Notes. Then check the procedure code on the Claim Lines tab — it is 36415, not the 99213 the note names, so the instruction does not apply.
steps.checklistItem: Review the SPI-NOA limited liability record against the claim

steps.name: Pay the claim
steps.description: Select 'Pay' from the action menu dropdown on the claim header and click Submit.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Pay decision is submitted.
steps.hint: Choose 'Pay' in the decision dropdown on the claim header, then click Submit.
